entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He grinned. Laurento jumped in smoo..."
entries.dialogueText: He grinned. Laurento jumped in smoothly.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The meeting room should be ready b..."
entries.dialogueText: "The meeting room should be ready by now. Shall we proceed?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Lespia's statement was unprompted,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia's statement was unprompted, Mr. President. It would have been against AN protocol to interrupt it."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We're already beginning to find co..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're already beginning to find common ground. I'm optimistic for these negotiations."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""You are correct, Mr. President. As..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are correct, Mr. President. As a member of GRACE, our kingdom does not officially support or oppose any superpower."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He led us into the next room over,..."
entries.dialogueText: He led us into the next room over, where a set of blue-upholstered armchairs were arranged around a circular table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The three of us had a seat. A palac..."
entries.dialogueText: The three of us had a seat. A palace aide came by with water and coffee.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Now that you're here, Mr. Smolak,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that you're here, Mr. Smolak, can you explain in greater detail why you decided to postpone the Zille handover?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak took a sip of water. He slow..."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak took a sip of water. He slowly wiped his mustache.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It is simple, Mr. Esquibel.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is simple, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Zille is now home to several milli..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zille is now home to several million citizens of Wehzek origin. Under the terms of the treaty our predecessors signed, they were to have the right to stay and work in the region."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""But the Zille attack made it clear..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the Zille attack made it clear that those terms would not be respected. Without the protection of my government, I fear further violence will come to those who stay."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What about the Rizians whose homes..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about the Rizians whose homes were destroyed by your civil war? You didn't seem to care about their safety."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The war was devastating to Rizians..."
entries.dialogueText: "The war was devastating to Rizians and Wehzeks alike, but you cannot blame me for the mistakes of my predecessor. I have spent the last decade helping my nation recover from that terrible tragedy."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Your actions, both prior to and in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your actions, both prior to and in the wake of the Zille incident, have shown your disregard for Wehzek lives."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You have been nothing but cooperat..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have been nothing but cooperative since the Zille incident, I will grant you that."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Your actions in the wake of the Zi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your actions in the wake of the Zille incident revealed your true feelings about Wehlen and its people."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Meanwhile, we are worried about th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Meanwhile, we are worried about the impact the loss of Zille will have on our economy. We will need a way to stabilize our currency."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""But do they have access to the lar..."
entries.dialogueText: "But do they have access to the largest poppy fields in Merkopa?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""She's right, your mother. A puff o..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's right, your mother. A puff of our khisha and a sip of your wine... I can't think of a more delightful combination."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Smolak, we are negotiating for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Smolak, we are negotiating for the legal return of my territory, not haggling in some Wehzek bazaar."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Our timber industry is also unpara..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our timber industry is also unparalleled in Merkopa. Your nobles might take a particular interest in our woodcarvings..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The morphine my country produces h..."
entries.dialogueText: "The morphine my country produces has been used on battlefields across the continent. Wars have been won because of it."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Haggling, negotiating -- either wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Haggling, negotiating -- either way, it's all about who can offer what and who wants it more. Right, Mr. Esquibel?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've never heard of Wehzek woodcar..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've never heard of Wehzek woodcarvings."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Our artisans only serve the most e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our artisans only serve the most exclusive customers, Your Majesty. Each piece can take years to complete."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We don't plan on going into battle..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't plan on going into battle, President Smolak. But access to lower-cost pharmaceuticals would benefit our health system."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I know shops in Iza's Little Wracl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know shops in Iza's Little Wraclawitz quarter that sell khisha under the table. They can't restock it fast enough."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""A few of my family's heirlooms are..."
entries.dialogueText: "A few of my family's heirlooms are Wehzek handiwork. They still look good as new after a century."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Indeed, Mr. Esquibel. There is a r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, Mr. Esquibel. There is a reason your poorer citizens cross into Zille to buy simple painkillers."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Your Majesty, Mr. Esquibel... how..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, Mr. Esquibel... how much do you know about the Bludish Freedom Front?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They were founded in protest of Ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "They were founded in protest of Tarquin Soll's policies in Sordland. They've been active around the border between your countries."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shook his head."
entries.dialogueText: He shook his head.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They're a coalition of radical sep..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're a coalition of radical separatists who've lost their purpose since their leader was jailed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They're a resistance group fightin..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're a resistance group fighting against the oppression of the Bludish people. They've been forced to commit some extreme acts over their history."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They're a dangerous terror organiz..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're a dangerous terror organization whose fight for 'freedom' has cost many innocents their lives."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""That may have been how they starte..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may have been how they started. But the threat they pose is not limited to that one small region."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""President Smolak, I am aware that..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Smolak, I am aware that the BFF has not gone completely inactive since the retirement of Tarquin Soll. And that they may in fact be gathering their strength."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shook his head."
entries.dialogueText: He shook his head.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Dewlen Arge was one head of a many..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dewlen Arge was one head of a many-headed beast. Cutting him off only made the others angrier."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Forced?""
entries.dialogueText: "Forced?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The Bluds have been offered every..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Bluds have been offered every opportunity to live alongside Wehzeks and Sords. They chose violence instead."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Very good, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very good, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. President, I can't ban people..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I can't ban people from my country based on their religion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia is duty-bound to welcome our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia is duty-bound to welcome our fellow Wruhecists. Even if they belong to a fringe sect."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can get behind a Bludish ban. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can get behind a Bludish ban. But banning Derdians would have huge international ramifications."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Derdians are a nationality, not a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Derdians are a nationality, not a religion. And Wehzek Bluds are an ethnic group as distinctly marked in their identification documents."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""This is not about Wruhecism. It is..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is not about Wruhecism. It is about terrorists and those who support them."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""That may be so, Mr. Smolak. But th..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may be so, Mr. Smolak. But the international community would see this as a religious ban."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whether Derdian or Bludish, Golcon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whether Derdian or Bludish, Golcondism is not compatible with Rizian values. That much we can agree on."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""As huge as those of granting a saf..."
entries.dialogueText: "As huge as those of granting a safe haven to radical terrorists?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Mr. Smolak, we are prepared to inc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Smolak, we are prepared to increase our border security, but an outright ban on Bluds and Derdians will be seen as religious discrimination."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree that closer cultural and e..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree that closer cultural and economic ties could benefit both of our nations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What precisely do you mean by 'fri..."
entries.dialogueText: "What precisely do you mean by 'friendship'? A military alliance?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you are concerned about Rizian..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you are concerned about Rizian nationalists attacking Wehzek citizens, I must warn you that such measures will only make them more angry."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Not quite. We in Wehlen do not req..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not quite. We in Wehlen do not require the Rizian military's help to defend ourselves."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""They would indeed. After all, how..."
entries.dialogueText: "They would indeed. After all, how well can Rumburg look after you when you're so far away from each other?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Why so cynical, Your Majesty? Our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why so cynical, Your Majesty? Our countries were close allies once. They can be again."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""If the fate of Wehlen is as closel..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the fate of Wehlen is as closely entwined with Rizia's as my proposal outlines, your nationalists will only be fighting against themselves."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento pulled a folder out of his..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento pulled a folder out of his briefcase and opened it on the table.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Mr. President, we received the dra..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, we received the draft from your ministers, but the terms were extremely vague. You're asking for a trade deal, a bilateral migration agreement and... a counter-terrorism cooperation pact?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell me more about this trade deal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me more about this trade deal, President Smolak."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm interested in hearing more abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm interested in hearing more about this anti-terrorism pact."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. Their religious fanaticism ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Their religious fanaticism makes them even more dangerous."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't see why their beliefs are..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So I hear. Aren't they the largest..."
entries.dialogueText: "So I hear. Aren't they the largest Golcondist community outside of Derdia?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Their beliefs are important to the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their beliefs are important to the Republic of Derdia. Which has been granting sanctuary even to the most notorious of Bludish criminals."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Their beliefs are shared by the Re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their beliefs are shared by the Republic of Derdia. Which has been granting sanctuary even to the most notorious of Bludish criminals."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Precisely. And in fact, Jorga Azma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely. And in fact, Jorga Azmal's country has been granting sanctuary even to the most notorious of Bludish criminals."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""My request is simple.""
entries.dialogueText: "My request is simple."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""All Wehzek Bluds and Derdian citiz..."
entries.dialogueText: "All Wehzek Bluds and Derdian citizens are to be turned away at the Rizian border."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""This is not strictly about Golcond..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is not strictly about Golcondism. It is about terrorists and those who support them."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I do understand your concerns, how..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do understand your concerns, however. I might be willing to leave Derdia out of our agreement if enough of our other conditions are met."

entries.dialogueText: "There is no honor among criminals, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: "Unless..."

entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Well, Your Majesty, let's say the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Your Majesty, let's say the Republic of Wehlen decided to take a more proactive approach to the BFF problem."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento nervously adjusted his tie..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento nervously adjusted his tie.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""If your kingdom promised to direct..."
entries.dialogueText: "If your kingdom promised to directly aid us in that, it would of course be far more valuable than any form of border control."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Proactive'? 'Problem'? I don't li..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What kind of aid would be required?""

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am all for proactivity. If we do..."

entries.dialogueText: "Indeed not, President Smolak. I hope that your so-called solution does not involve retaliatory violence."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Or...""

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Or what?""

entries.dialogueText: "Nothing so vulgar, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It is our long-term goal to drive..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is our long-term goal to drive the insurgents out of their strongholds in the north of our country. Once that happens, we suspect some will flee south towards Zille."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Were the ban limited to only those..."
entries.dialogueText: "Were the ban limited to only those with Bludish identification documents, we would have a far easier time implementing it. Surely you understand."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Yes! See, Wehlen and Rizia have mu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes! See, Wehlen and Rizia have much in common."

entries.dialogueText: "What exactly are you planning, President Smolak? Do you require the services of our armed forces?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak

entries.dialogueText: "Our navy is currently preoccupied with Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can extend those rights to the W..."

entries.dialogueText: "I had a plan, but it seems the Rizian Navy is too small to assist us. If that's the case, there's little point in asking you to stop them from crossing the strait."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""A wise leader knows when to pick h..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Let's hope that day comes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's hope that day comes."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""As I will in act in mine.""
entries.dialogueText: "As I will in act in mine."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""There are always other terms we ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are always other terms we can look at."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our proud navy stands ready to ens..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our proud navy stands ready to ensure the security of the strait. We are prepared to guard our waters."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Now that is the kind of determinat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that is the kind of determination I like to see. A strong navy securing the strait benefits both our nations."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""With Rizia standing firm, those in..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Rizia standing firm, those insurgents will have nowhere to run. I almost feel bad for them. Almost."
